RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel signals poor gender diversity at senior levels and increases the risk of implicit "similar-to-me" bias. However, for a head of risk modelling, regulatory affairs experience is a critical leadership qualification that often outweighs purely technical credentials, providing a credible business rationale. 

Raising the panel's gender composition directly with the bank will appear combative and damage professional relationships without offering legal proof of discrimination. Instead, follow up politely on your feedback request to understand specific gaps, and only consult an employment specialist if you uncover substantive procedural irregularities or evidence of disparate treatment.
